_help: Google Analytics 4 through Google Tag Manager, with the cookie consent bar (card SAG-44). container_id: the GTM container, like GTM-XXXXXXX; empty = GTM, the bar and the 'Cookie settings' links are all off. Nothing is loaded from Google until the visitor accepts: build.js writes the Consent Mode v2 defaults (everything denied) at the top of <head> on every page (never in /admin), and GTM is loaded only after 'accept', with analytics_storage only. privacy_href: where 'Privacy policy' links go, per language (pages built from src/privacy/). consent_days: how long a choice is remembered; the privacy notice states this number, so change both together. consent_version: raise by 1 when the bar's wording or the tools change, so every visitor is asked again. The bar's wording and the dataLayer events are in consent.js. After editing: node build.js, then deploy (with approval).
